The '''Skirmish at Traygura's Hideout''' was an event that took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] at the crime boss's [[Traygura's hideout|hideout]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]].<ref name="TSC" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], accompanied by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] attempted to infiltrate [[Traygura]]'s hideout in pursuit of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal [[T'mott Zoat]], who had recently entered the crime boss's employ. To Kenobi's surprise, Pryce betrayed him, trading the Jedi for a share of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] ransom, and a position as Traygura's official smuggler.<ref name="TSC" /> 

Outnumbered and at a disadvantage, Kenobi was soon reinforced by his friends [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], shifting the balance. Kenobi chased after the fleeing Zoat, leaving the remaining gang members to his companions. Howeverm, the Jedi Master was forced into a stalemate by the Shistavanen criminal and, in the moment of reflection that followed, admitted the mistake of allowing his pride to dictate his actions. Calling for assistance, Kenobi joined forces with Skywalker and Tano, and together subdued Zoat. With both Zoat and Traygura defeated, the rest of the gang surrendered. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] subsequently turned the entire gang over planet's authorities.<ref name="TSC" />
